svg.title: physio-forensics
svg.desc: Five dials show the pulse phase in four skin regions for real video and four forgery types; the arrow's length is the phase-locking value: real 0.998, nopulse 0.645, incoherent 0.416, drifting 0.287, swap 0.185. Bars compare AUC on an unseen forgery method: phase-coherence features average 0.981, signal-quality features 0.866.
